methods.formerRustUnitTestReason: the assertions after the first hooked call are assertSameResults/assertNotSameResults (lines 2487-2498, helpers 2913-2949): they compare printed JS source strings that the test's private printHelper computes by building its own Compiler (createCompiler, getOptions, init, parseInputs), running getProcessor(compiler).process(externsRoot, mainRoot) directly and printing with compiler.toSource(mainRoot), outside every hooked harness API. The compared objects are produced by that test-local Java code in compilations that are never recorded (gate (b) caveat on printHelper), so they are no post-call state of the method's hooked test(...) calls (records 518-523, the NaN/Infinity self-comparisons, which replay their expected output 'true'/'false'); those records carry only postCall.compiler.externProperties, postCall.compiler.accessorSummary and postCall.compiler.allowableFeatures (no postCall.pass key), none of which holds a printHelper result
